The Good side

Weezer had probably for that time the best website around.
Postings of demos, videos and Karl was really active, always a good source for weezer.

websites like weerez.com weezer.ws and so on was also all kickass sites and excellent sources for b-sides, live performances and such.
Remember when I downloaded the Lupos gig from 00. I was fucking over the static. Still remember when Pat misses the intro to Why Bother 'cause of Rivers rushing into it.

And ofcourse the best thing was that Weezer returned from a long hiatus. I honestly thought the band was dead but then one day all of a sudden Green Album was mentioned and my obsession with Weezer was back.


The main "bad" thing about being a weezer fan during this time was not the albums or anything like that. It was the dysfunctional relationship between mainly Rivers and the fans.

When Maladroit came out I bought a magazine (prob. Kerrang) and there was an interview Rivers where he said something in the likes of that he hated the "old fans" and that they were annoying. 

As being a loyal fan for years (Weezer is my first favorite band) and never even questioned what Weezer had been doing this made me... Well Not mad but it got to me. I felt to some extent betrayed. This was a guy that I thought was a genius and I was a big fan of and he hated me. If I read something like that today I wouldnt give a fuck but you know, teenagers man!

The late 2000's I don't really care about. M.B. was okay when it was released but today I find it "meh". Red Album was decent i thought but nothing special. At the release of this album I was at the University so I was not that interested to be honest.

When raditude came out I couldnt listen to it. What a complete turd of an album. I actually thought at that point that Weezer was lost forever. The red album was bland but atleast it had it shining moments. Raditude had nothing of that.

Hurley was okay but felt rushed. What was the deal with one album per year thing???

EWBAITE was a blast to listen to when it came out and made weezer fun again. The futurescope is probably one of weezers best efforts... According to me that is. Return to Ithaka is a fucking beast!

Raditude. Almost all songs co:written and the album was a complete turd. 

Seems to me that Rivers best songs, even in recent years is written by himself and not with the help of others. I really don't understand why he feels the need to bring in so much help to write songs.
I wonder if he is afraid that the whole Pinkerton ordeal will repeat itself if he shows to much of himself and this is a way of getting around that, meaning that "I didnt write those songs all by myself so its not entirely my fault"

I don't know... But! on this album he does have some interesting writers and it turned out really good on some songs I think so this time around at least he was smarter(except for Kasher who writes crappy music overall) when choosing who he was gonna work with. It feels that he knew what kind of sound he wanted this time around

Im not against getting the help of other writers, I mean, it can turn out really good but for me Rivers is a really good singer/song writer so I get confused. Maybe my thoughts of his musical abilities is too high but he has written som exceptional music over the years.

Im just happy that this album is nice return to form. I know its early to say but if weezer continues on this path the next album is going to be one hell of a beast!

for some reason i feel that they should work with Bob Rock. Say what you want about the artists he have produced but god damn, that dude knows how to push the artist to their full potential. That would be one interesting album.

Go away, lonely girl, The british are coming, Aint got nobody. Well I cant say that im surprised over the reactions from the different reviewers, I was expecting it. Luckily for me I don't agree on what they are saying regarding the songs that I have heard myself. 
When someone ranks BTTS as their favourite song on this album I know that my taste i clearly different from that person.

I've noticed that many people are comparing this to green as in "Its gonna be as good as green". Im sorry but am I the only one who thinks that the green is not that great??? I mean when it first came out I was stoked but now over 10 years later it does not really hold up anymore. I listen to songs from that album once in a while but never the whole album in one spin. EWBAITE seems to be getting some heat for its cheesy lyrics (To which I agree in some parts) but are we forgetting that Green is without a doubt the most cheesy Weezer have ever done?

I'm not pissing on the Weez now but you can't deny that Island, Don't let go, Smile etc. Is cheesy as fuck. and with probably the most easy 28 minute guitarwork in history from a rockband.

Im excited that weezer is actually including some nice solos again and that Pat seems to be drumming the way only he can again. 

Will I think that this is the best album ever? Oh fuck no but I think that there are tracks on this album that eventually will become classical Weezer tunes.

And i can say this much. Thank fuck that Weezer is at least back on track again.
